description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for verifying submodule ref storage format handling in git repositories. It automates the setup, configuration, adding, cloning, status checks, and updating of repositories and submodules with different ref storage formats to ensure correct behavior.

methods.name: test_ref_format
methods.description: A function that writes a reference format string to 'expect' and compares it with the output of 'git rev-parse --show-ref-format' for a given repository directory.
